m_AbilityList (TresASProxyTresControlsList), rows TresUIP_CampMenuAbilityListItem: m_AbilityName, m_AbilityPoint, m_AbilityEquippable, m_CategoryName, m_TextIcon
open slot 80 0x1415C9390; build 0x1415CD820 -> 0x1415CF300; row display slot 79 0x1415CF730
owned abilities of the chosen character

one row per OWNED COPY (0x140E8B640: bits 0, 4, 8 of the record word), categories in the order Actions, Mobility, Support, inside a category by m_UIPriority ascending (stable): copies of one ability are adjacent rows; row record 0x70 bytes: +0 id, +0x28 AP cost (m_UseAP), +0x30 NEW state, +0x34 equipped (0x140E8ECE0), +0x60 may be toggled, +0x64 copy index. Abilities from equipment or food are not listed. Triangle steps through read-only pages of each Keyblade (Form Actions, Shotlocks)
90 frames: off(1) in(9) loop(19) out(27) left(39) right(65)
m_NowUseApNum, m_MaxApNum, m_ApGauge (201 frames), m_ApIncreaseGauge, m_ApLackGauge, m_NowUseApAnim (normal / equippable / lack), m_ApCountNum, m_MaxApCountNum, m_ApLimitAnim

used = sum of m_UseAP over equipped rows; max = status snapshot value 13 (max AP); gauge frame = F(used, max, 200) + 1. With the cursor on an unequipped row the number shows used + cost, the label is equippable or lack (over the maximum) and the preview gauge shows F(used + cost, max, 200) + 1
90 frames: off(1) in(9) loop(19) out(27) left(39) right(65)
decide (event 7) in slot 78 0x1415C59B0; rule refresh 0x1415D2A00; SetEquipped 0x140E95E90(record, id, copy, on)

unequipped row: allowed iff cost <= maxAP - usedAP and equippedRows < maxRows (1000; 30 with code-menu option A2) and not (id in {4, 5, 6} while another of {4, 5, 6} is equipped): Counter Slash / Counter Impact / Counter Kick exclude each other. Equipped row: always removable. SetEquipped needs the owned bit (0 / 4 / 8) and writes the equipped bit (1 / 5 / 9); it has no other caller than this screen. Zero EXP (id 26) asks for confirmation. m_MaxEquip is never read. Effect is immediate (the record word is what gameplay counts)
90 frames: off(1) in(9) loop(19) out(27) left(39) right(65)
sounds: static SE 1 on success, 4 when refused. A newly granted ability is owned + NEW (bit 2 / 6 / 10), not equipped

rows = inventory entries of the id ranges 0x101-0x10B, 0x201-0x205, 0x300-0x364, 0x401-0x434, 0x501-0x570, 0x601-0x638, 0x701-0x73C, 0x801-0x83B, 0x901-0x90D, 0xA01, sorted; tabs All / Items / Weapons / Materials / Key Items / Armor / Accessories with L2 / R2. Decide on an item of category 1 or 2: target buttons; decide on a member applies it from the stock (refused: dialog_0002 / dialog_0003). Triangle: Discard after dialog_0001
sounds: static SE 30 on use (31 for ids 0x202-0x205), 4 with no copies
open slot 80 0x1415E5540; equipped list 0x1415F0F40; stock list 0x1415E66D0; input slot 78 0x1415E30D0
equipped slots and the stock for one slot

equipped list = one row per open slot: weapons (record+0x80, 3), armour (+0x98), accessories (+0xD8), items (+0x118); row 0x38 bytes: +0 item id, +4 kind 0..3, +8 slot index, +0x30 auto-reload, +0x31 used and waiting for refill. Decide opens the stock list filtered by item category (3 / 4 / 5 / 1) with the current item as row 0. Square removes (not the current Keyblade: dialog_0001). Triangle on an item row toggles Auto-Reload for that item kind (0x1415E8430); on other rows it shows the piece's abilities. L2 / R2 change the party member
0x1415EC620(newItem, row) -> commit 0x1415ECC00 (0x140E98060 weapon, 0x140E977D0 armour, 0x140E94EF0 accessory, 0x140E94F90 item slot)

1. if the removed piece gives AP and the new one less: abilities in use must fit in maxAP + delta, else dialog_0003; 2. the removed piece must fit back into the stock (dialog_0002); 3. commit: slot written, old piece back to stock, new one out of stock, status rebuilt (0x140EA81D0), assets requested (0x140EB2F40). In force at once
piece values and the change preview

preview per value: current (status snapshot) and difference: AP new.m_AP - old.m_AP, Strength m_AttackPlus, Magic m_MagicPlus, Defense m_DefensePlus likewise; max HP / MP difference always 0; resists recomputed with the piece swapped (multiplicative rule) minus current. Keyblades use the upgraded row (0x14112EBD0)
Keyblade switch order (D-pad right / left on Attack)

next = the following non-empty slot in the order 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 0, previous the other way; nothing with one Keyblade or with the weapon restriction; the switch is state WEAPONCHANGE (32). Active slot = record+6
input slot 78 0x1415E1FA0; storage S = GW+0x13CE0: magicSlot[6] at S+0x30 (0x140E8BA80 / 0x140E970B0), linkSlot[5] at S+0x48, hand-chosen-tier bits at S+0x5C (0x140E95E20)
order and tier of the Magic commands; order of the Links

decide on a slot shows the three tiers of its element; choosing a learned tier writes that kind into the slot and sets the slot bit at S+0x5C (a lower tier can be put into the command menu). Triangle picks a slot up; moving the focus then swaps the two slots (kind and bit); Triangle again drops it
corrects magic spec J 2.2 (lower tiers are selectable here)
assignable lists 0x1415EA9C0; write 0x1415EED00 -> 0x140E97F10(S, page, slot, kind)
shortcut sets A / B / C (shortcut[3][4] at S+0x00)

list tabs All / Magic / Links / Items (only non-empty ones, L2 / R2): every learned magic kind of every tier (asset order of CustomizeDataAsset.MagicCommands), every learned link, every item command whose item was ever obtained. Decide writes the entry; the same command may sit in several slots. Square clears the slot. A new game has 12 empty slots
with six elements at tier 3: 18 magic entries
